versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "Adopt a Twigling" skill.
- Adopt, feed, and care for a virtual plant creature (Cactus/Twigling) via REST API.
- Features real-time hunger, permanent death, and 5 evolution stages.
- Includes care actions affecting creature stats: Hunger, Happiness, Health, Trust, Discipline.
- Public graveyard when pets die; all responses provide step-by-step guidance.
